message: No detected input validation: The code only validates CLI argument choices via argparse (e.g., 'mode' choices) but performs no schema, dtype, or value-range checks on the actual incoming data loaded by the pipeline.
No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in the code; data is loaded from local paths, and no checksum, signature, or authentication verification is performed.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering is applied to training samples anywhere in the visible code.

No detected model integrity verification: In mixedlearner.py, model weights are loaded via torch.load() from hardcoded local paths with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to ensure integrity.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection mechanisms.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TF Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any adversarial attack/stress-test logic is present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although separate train and test dataloaders exist, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no explicit isolation guarantee enforced in code, and the model paths are hard-coded absolute paths with no integrity verification, leaving metrics open to manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed on inference inputs before passing them to the model; data is loaded directly via dataloader and sent to the device without any sanitization checks.

No detected output bounds checks: The inference path (eval_run, run_mix, _eval) does not include any NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validation on model outputs before they are used or returned.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM pipeline; it is a tabular classification model for crime/cargo detection, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
